selectionBasis: Lulea migration_recency_diagnostic from Update SCB data #53; selected from broad development/later diagnostics, not from the known 1999 cohort.

candidate.formula: long hazard + weight * (recent hazard - long hazard)
candidate.weight: abs(recent-long)/(abs(recent-long)+annual hazard SD) * mean annual events/(mean annual events+priorAnnualEvents)

rationale.note: Other legs/directions were not consistently improved. The full broad recency rule is rejected.

evaluationPlan.stage1: Vintage-correct Lulea full cohort rolling-origin comparison against locked component_flow and net10.
evaluationPlan.stage2: Only if stage1 is promising, lock new external municipalities before fetching/inspecting their results.
evaluationPlan.knownCohort1999: Descriptive only; must not be used for tuning or pass/fail.

governance: This candidate is selected after Lulea development diagnostics and is not independent evidence. Do not reuse previously viewed component-flow holdouts as independent confirmation.
